headline: ECB's Schnabel: Recent Energy Price Developments Are Quite Concerning

immediate.rationale: Higher energy-driven inflation risk raises ECB tightening pressure and equity discount rates.

next_session.rationale: Persistent energy inflation concern can continue to weigh on euro-area equities.

predictions.mechanism: Energy inflation -> hawkish ECB repricing -> higher yields -> lower equity valuations.
predictions.invalidation: Rapid fall in energy prices or dovish ECB clarification.
